About.title: About me
About.intro: I'm a software engineer, graduate of Universidad Modelo (Mérida, Mexico). I enjoy building complete products —from the database schema to the last animation— and lately I focus on integrating artificial intelligence into real applications.
About.nowBody: I work as a web development intern in the innovation department at {company}, and in parallel I'm taking a Data Science & Data Analytics program at Desafío Latam.
